raised: Not sure whether they count as 'reached retirement age'; the page doesn't say what that age is
If the 6-year rule applies, the money is locked until 67
Orange warning box (early withdrawal is expensive, 47%) was a bit scary
The '123 places / calculated / entered' markers at the top are confusing and unexplained
Didn't open 'play with your own numbers' for fear of breaking something
Codes like TXH-09 and KH-15 in 'worth knowing' mean nothing
Two cards in 'money in and out' were cut off and unreadable
'What the site took into account' text was cut off
The 415 ₪ difference seems tiny; the employer's 7.5% is left out of the comparison and isn't the headline, so they nearly concluded it isn't worth it
Confused that the example deposit is 500 ₪ but only 300 ₪ counts as a tax-favoured deposit
Unclear whether the costs of 2,402.23 are over 10 years or per year
Only half understands 'real profit', even after reading the terms table
Didn't understand the −342.02 ₪ to 2,106 ₪ range or whether they could come out worse off
Couldn't find what happens when they stop working or retire (employer deposits, leaving the money in)
Couldn't find what happens to the money if they die before withdrawing
Couldn't find whether starting at 61 is worth it compared with adding to the pension
Couldn't find how to learn their own first-payment date if they already have an old fund
Couldn't find the actual fees companies charge, only the ceiling
Would drop the 'worth knowing too' and 'what you can invest in' buttons
Would drop the 'where it appears' column
Would drop the 'who offers it and who supervises' section
Would drop the brokerage-account comparison and the paragraph about investment houses

problems.why: The reader only skimmed 'worth knowing', mentioning the new-account note and the meaningless codes, and never said anything about moving a study fund between companies or about partial transfers.
